inlineNotice.neutralMessage: This version is visible only to you.
inlineNotice.warningMessage: Your trial ends in three days.
inlineNotice.compositionPrefix: Payment could not be completed for
inlineNotice.inlineMessage: Only team members can open this URL.
inlineNotice.inlineAfter: Share it after access is configured.
inlineNotice.usageBody: Use the default subtle variant for brief emphasis inside prose, table cells, form summaries, or compact rows. Its raised neutral surface keeps attention low while Badge communicates category or status independently.
inlineNotice.emphasizedBody: Use the emphasized variant only when the whole message needs semantic weight. Its required tone controls the container; matching the Badge status is recommended but not enforced.
inlineNotice.alertBody: Use Alert instead when the message needs a title, description, leading icon, larger action area, or its own block in the page layout.
inlineNotice.accessibilityBody: Variant, tone, and Badge appearance are visual only. InlineNotice and Badge do not create a live region, so static content is not announced unexpectedly.
inlineNotice.liveRegionBody: For a polite dynamic update, add role="status" to InlineNotice. Reserve role="alert" for urgent errors that require immediate announcement.
inlineNotice.variantProp: Subtle uses the neutral raised surface and is the default. Emphasized uses a semantic surface and requires tone.
inlineNotice.toneProp: Required when variant is emphasized and unavailable for subtle. Controls the container foreground and surface colours.
inlineNotice.roleProp: Optional ARIA role inherited from the native span. Use status for polite updates and alert only for urgent errors.
inlineNotice.childrenProp: A Badge or other phrasing content, plus optional InlineNoticeContent and InlineNoticeAction parts.
inlineNotice.classNameProp: Additional classes applied to the inline notice container.
inlineNotice.contentPart: Flexible message area for text and simple phrasing content such as links or code.
inlineNotice.actionPart: Optional trailing slot for a compact link or text action.
